name: Noth the Plaguebringer
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/naxxramas/noth.md: 1,492,487 HP (classicdb), balcony schedule from the wiki and DBM-Vanilla, whose balcony lengths after the first cycle are marked 'Unknown in Classic'. The HP clock is 90 s + 110 s + 150 s of ground time (the wiki's 80% / 50% / 0% benchmarks) with 73 s and 90 s balcony phases between them, 8:33 total; real kills are 7 to 9 minutes and he is expected to die before the third balcony, so the third balcony (two Guardian waves, 'unsurvivable') is not scripted. Room geometry is an estimate: a 36 yd round room, three bone piles NW / NE / SW per the wiki. CURSE OF THE PLAGUEBRINGER (the fight's real mechanic). Real: up to 20 players cursed at once, 10 s, Curse; if it expires it detonates Wrath of the Plaguebringer on everyone within 35 yd. Here: four curse copies land together on the raid (playerChance 0.35 on you), decursed one per GCD. Only Druids and Mages can decurse, so the healer and ranged roles have the button (`dispels` curse; the healer also has magic for Cripple) and the melee and tank roles do not, because the engine cannot have a ghost raider decurse. Each copy, if still up 9.9 s after landing, fires its own Wrath on the decurser player: a `conditional: debuff:curseN` debuff with 680/s for 10 s, the sum of 1,758 initial + 875 to 1,125 every 2 s. Several Wraths at once kill you, as the wiki says ('an instant wipe if several go off'), though the real one hits everyone within 35 yd and the engine's Wrath lands only on the player's decurser role, so melee and tank roles never see a Wrath and the player's own run is the only one that can fail. BLINK every ~25 s (wiki, WT; no DBM timer) teleports Noth about 20 yd to one of three spots (`teleportBossTo`), wipes threat (`threatWipe`) and casts Cripple on his target (Magic, 15 s, -50% move/attack speed/Strength; here `damageTakenMult` 1.25 because the engine cannot slow you). Cripple hits everyone within 20 yd of him; here only the tank's copy is modelled. The tank Taunts or runs back; the ghost tank re-taunts after a delay. WT's 'stop DPS until the MT has him' is modelled as a 2.2 s `shield` (the ghost tank's re-taunt delay) (`bossOnly`, no reflect, roles dps): attacks on him during it count as `attacksIntoShield`, a stand-in for the real risk of taking him off the tank. Real Blink does not apply a shield; that is the workaround for the engine having no threat-based penalty while the boss is loose. Cripple dispels the MT (Priest or Paladin) are on the healer's DISPEL note. SKELETONS: 3 Plagued Warriors every 30 s from three bone piles (`adds`, one per pile; first 12 s, jitter 3, inside DBM's 6.5 to 22.7 s window). The off-tank role holds the NW pile; another group takes NE and SW (`playerFrom`). Warriors are killable but not kill-first while Noth is up: the raid burns them over 22 s. BALCONY phases are `submerged` (Noth untargetable; 73 s and 90 s, wiki/DBM): wave 1 at +3 s, wave 2 at +33 s (DBM adds timer 3 s after arrival, then every 30 s), kill-first adds the raid must kill. Balcony 1 is two Champion waves, balcony 2 is Champions then Guardians (per wiki, Wowhead); per-wave counts are not in any fetched source, so one add per pile per wave is an estimate. Champions' Mortal Strike is a 6 s `healingMult` 0.5 debuff with 450/s on the add tank (values unknown in research, estimated); Guardian Arcane Explosion is a random `hazard` on melee and the off-tank, estimated at 3,000. On his return (`first: 0` one-shot `threatWipe` in the next ground phase, the wiki's 'threat is reset') the tank Taunts him immediately. Curse continues on the ground only; DBM's 10 s-after-return first cast is used. Damage is scaled to a 10,000 HP tank, so a tank survives normal play but dies if the healer ignores a spike. Noth swings for 1,100 per 2 s on a 10,000 HP tank (real base 8,475 to 9,727, pre-mitigation), so with Cripple up (x1.25) the swing alone is more than the 140/s a healer player's ghost gets passively, and an idle healer loses the tank repeatedly. Skeleton, Champion and Guardian melee damage is not modelled in the engine (adds do not hit). Plagued Warrior cleave, Champion Shadow Shock, Shackle Undead, Guardian stun-lock and the third balcony are not modelled.

ghostOfftankSpot.label: Other off-tanks: the rest of the piles

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold Noth in the centre of the room. He Blinks about every 25 seconds, wipes all threat and Cripples you. Taunt him the moment he lands and walk him back. When he comes back down from the balcony threat is wiped again: Taunt at once.

offtank.label: Bone pile tank
offtank.description: You hold the NW bone pile. Plagued Warriors spawn there every 30 seconds, and on the balcony phases Champions and Guardians do too. Grab them before they reach a healer. Face them away from the raid.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Noth is the priority while he is on the ground. When he Blinks, stop attacking until the main tank has him again. When he goes up to the balcony, kill the adds with everyone else.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: You are a Decurser too. Every Curse of the Plaguebringer has to come off within 10 seconds or it blows up as Wrath on the raid. Press Decurse until there are none left, then go back to your target.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Keep the tank up, Decurse every Curse within 10 seconds, and dispel Cripple off the main tank. Your button stands for both your Druids (Curse) and your Priests (Cripple). On the balcony phases keep your add tank alive through Mortal Strike.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Remove a Curse (Druid, Mage) or Cripple (Priest, Paladin). One button stands in for all of them.

curse1.label: Curse of the Plaguebringer
curse1.tip: Up to twenty players are cursed. Decurse every one within 10 seconds or it blows up as Wrath of the Plaguebringer on the raid. Druids and mages only.

wrath1.label: Wrath of the Plaguebringer
wrath1.tip: A Curse expired undecursed and went off on the raid. Several of these at once is a wipe.

curse2.label: Curse of the Plaguebringer
curse2.tip: Up to twenty players are cursed. Decurse every one within 10 seconds or it blows up as Wrath of the Plaguebringer on the raid. Druids and mages only.

wrath2.label: Wrath of the Plaguebringer
wrath2.tip: A Curse expired undecursed and went off on the raid. Several of these at once is a wipe.

curse3.label: Curse of the Plaguebringer
curse3.tip: Up to twenty players are cursed. Decurse every one within 10 seconds or it blows up as Wrath of the Plaguebringer on the raid. Druids and mages only.

wrath3.label: Wrath of the Plaguebringer
wrath3.tip: A Curse expired undecursed and went off on the raid. Several of these at once is a wipe.

curse4.label: Curse of the Plaguebringer
curse4.tip: Up to twenty players are cursed. Decurse every one within 10 seconds or it blows up as Wrath of the Plaguebringer on the raid. Druids and mages only.

wrath4.label: Wrath of the Plaguebringer
wrath4.tip: A Curse expired undecursed and went off on the raid. Several of these at once is a wipe.

blinkA.label: Blink
blinkA.toast: Noth blinked: threat is wiped. Tank, Taunt him!
blinkA.tip: He blinks across the room, drops his whole threat table and Cripples whoever he was hitting. Tanks: Taunt him back. DPS: stop until the tank has him.

blinkB.label: Blink
blinkB.toast: Noth blinked: threat is wiped. Tank, Taunt him!
blinkB.tip: He blinks across the room, drops his whole threat table and Cripples whoever he was hitting. Tanks: Taunt him back. DPS: stop until the tank has him.

blinkC.label: Blink
blinkC.toast: Noth blinked: threat is wiped. Tank, Taunt him!
blinkC.tip: He blinks across the room, drops his whole threat table and Cripples whoever he was hitting. Tanks: Taunt him back. DPS: stop until the tank has him.

cripple.label: Cripple
cripple.tip: Cripple halves the tank's run speed and attack rate. Dispel it off the main tank.

blinkHold.label: Threat wiped
blinkHold.toast: He blinked. Stop until the tank has him.
blinkHold.tip: He dropped his whole threat table. Hit him now and he comes to you.

skel.label: Plagued Warriors
skel.tip: Rise, my soldiers. Three Plagued Warriors from the bone piles every 30 seconds.

skelAir.label: Plagued Warriors
skelAir.tip: They keep coming even while he is up on the balcony.

champions1.label: Plagued Champions
champions1.tip: Off-tank: the NW spawn is yours. Grab it before it reaches a healer.

champions2.label: Plagued Champions
champions2.tip: Off-tank: the NW spawn is yours. Grab it before it reaches a healer.

guardians.label: Plagued Guardians
guardians.tip: Off-tank: the NW spawn is yours. Grab it before it reaches a healer.

mortalStrike.label: Mortal Strike
mortalStrike.tip: A Champion's Mortal Strike halves the healing your add tank takes for 6 seconds. Bring big heals.

arcaneBurst.label: Arcane Explosion
arcaneBurst.tip: A Guardian is about to explode. Step out of the ring.

wipeOnReturn.label: He has no threat table
wipeOnReturn.toast: He is back and has no threat. Tank, Taunt!
wipeOnReturn.tip: Coming down from the balcony wipes his whole table. Taunt the moment he lands.

submerge.label: Noth teleports to the balcony
submerge.tip: He is gone for a while and his adds are not.

emerge.label: Noth returns
emerge.tip: He lands with no threat: tank, Taunt him at once.

expectations.label: Pick him up in the centre
expectations.tip: Tank him in the middle of the room with the raid around him.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds loose on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

attacksIntoShield.label: Attacks on Noth with no threat table
attacksIntoShield.tip: When he blinks nobody has threat. Stop for a moment and let the tank get him.

wraths.label: Wraths that went off
wraths.tip: Every Curse you let expire goes off on the raid.

cues.notes: Taunt him back after every Blink and after every return. Decurse every Curse. Grab your pile.

list.label: Taunt when Noth turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Decurse it
list.tip: Press Decurse until the last Curse is gone. One left and the raid eats a Wrath.

list.label: Grab your skeleton
list.tip: Run to the NW pile or Taunt it.

drills.name: Taunt back after every Blink
drills.description: He Blinks every 12 seconds and wipes threat every time. Taunt him the moment he lands.

drills.name: Decurse every Curse
drills.description: Curses land on the raid every 13 seconds. Press Decurse until they are all gone before the 10 s run out.

drills.name: Hold your bone pile
drills.description: A skeleton every 12 seconds from the NW pile. Pick it up before it reaches the raid.

drills.name: Stop when he Blinks
drills.description: He Blinks every 15 seconds. Stop attacking until the tank has him back.

drills.name: Kill the wave first
drills.description: A balcony wave. Kill the adds and do not let them reach the healers.

drills.name: Add tank through Mortal Strike
drills.description: A Mortal Strike every 7 seconds halves your heals on the add tank. Stay ahead of it.

limitations: Balcony waves and Cripple are simplified. Skeletons do not have independent abilities.
